about.description: STRATO is an Ethereum-compatible Layer 1 blockchain operated by BlockApps Inc., focused on real-world asset tokenization. STRATO hosts a precious-metals product line including GOLDST (vaulted gold) and SILVST (vaulted silver), each redeemable into physical metal stored with BA Gold Enterprises in New York. The platform also exposes a DeFi stack for borrowing, liquidity, and yield against vaulted RWAs, and publishes periodic vault audit reports.
about.registryInfo: BlockApps Inc. (Delaware) is the developer of STRATO, an Ethereum-compatible Layer 1 designed for real-world asset tokenization, with public materials describing BA Gold Enterprises Inc. as the New York vaulting partner for the precious-metals products.

platform.attestationFrequency: Monthly vaulting confirmations; periodic independent CPA audit

fees.revenueNotes: STRATO charges a vault/management fee and a mint/redemption spread on its precious-metals tokens, but the specific bps and revenue-sharing schedule are not publicly disclosed on the STRATO website or audit pages as of May 2026.
